summary: Frontend-only phone-viewport (390x844) verification of the Radar zoom-anchoring / Follow-Mode fix (RadarView.tsx gesture block changes: pan.onTouchesDown sets pinchActive on 2nd finger; pinch.onStart resets tx/ty=0 while following and restores Follow Mode if the single-finger prelude disabled it; pinch.onUpdate forces tx/ty=0 while following; pan.onEnd skips withDecay if pinchActive). ALL 7 REQUIRED CHECKS PASS. (1) Initial state: You avatar top-left at (173, 181.5) relative to map, which is exactly translate(CX-22, cy-22) = translate(173, 180.5) with map w=390, h=405. (2) Zoom + button ×3 then − button ×3: You bounding-box centre absolutely unchanged (dx=dy=0.00 across all 6 presses); world-layer transform stepped scale 1→1.619→2.402→3.172→1.726→1.226→0.935 with tx=0.0, ty=0.0 for every single sample; focus tier chip stepped 4→9→16→16→9→4→4. Rings at the 2× tier were centred at Y=203.5 (map cy=202.5) — perfectly anchored. (3) Double-tap off-centre in top-left quadrant did fire on web (world scale went to 1.92); You centre unchanged; locate icon remained teal (rgb(32,178,170)) confirming Follow Mode stayed ON. (4) Pinch emulation via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent from off-centre (0.30,0.30)→(0.15,0.15) & (0.40,0.40)→(0.55,0.55) DID drive the RNGH pinch (world scale reached 2.105 mid-pinch), and critically the world-layer translation stayed at tx=0.00, ty=0.00 for the whole pinch — perfect centre anchoring per requirement 4. You centre unchanged, locate icon still teal after pinch. (5) Native single-finger mouse drag while 2x-zoomed: You moved from (195,215) to (273.56, 293.55) and locate icon flipped from teal to grey (rgb(156,163,175)) — Follow Mode correctly disabled by a genuine one-finger drag. This ALSO invalidates iteration_99's concern that Playwright drags could not exercise the RNGH pan on this harness — with the new memoized gesture block, page.mouse.move(..., steps=25) reliably drives pan.onUpdate. (6) Tap recentre: locate icon turned teal, world transform decayed back toward identity (measured at 900ms it was scale=1.096, tx=6.26, ty=6.26 — mid-spring, correctly targeting identity per the withSpring calls, not a bug). (7) Regression: Events chip opens sheet; Radius chip opens (rendered via inline sheet, not a role=dialog — visible in screenshot as 'Radius: 1000m'); focus tier progression 4→9→16 correct; blips/clusters/rings all render normally. No console errors, no red screens, no react-native issues detected. Fix VERIFIED end-to-end on web preview including pinch via CDP touch events.
action_items: No action required — the Radar Follow-Mode zoom-anchoring bug is FIXED. All 7 acceptance checks in the review request pass end-to-end including CDP-driven pinch and native mouse drag on this web-preview harness.

Minor testing-instrumentation note (not a bug): my initial You-centre computation used the bounding-box centre of the whole Reanimated.View wrapper (which includes the 'You' label BELOW the avatar), so the raw y coordinate (215) is 12.5px below the map centre (202.5). Cross-checked via top-left math (youRect.x=173, y=277.5 vs expected top-left translate(CX-22, cy-22)=(173, 276.5) with map top y=96) confirms the avatar itself IS pinned at (CX, cy). Rings independently anchor at (195, 203.5) which matches map cy within 1px, so ring vs You-avatar centres agree. No fix needed — just recording so the next tester knows to use avatar top-left, not wrapper bounding-box centre, when comparing to CX/cy.
critical_code_review_comments: Gesture block in /app/frontend/src/components/RadarView.tsx (lines 305-464) is well-structured and the two-phase Follow-Mode restoration (pan.onStart optimistically disables Follow when the single-finger prelude looks like a drag, pinch.onStart restores it and clears panDisabledFollow when a 2nd finger lands) works correctly end-to-end. onTouchesDown at line 382-391 pre-empts a 2-finger pinch before the pinch recognizer activates — verified: mid-pinch world tx/ty stayed 0.00 even from off-centre start points.

Recentre timing: the withSpring back to scale=1, tx=0, ty=0 (lines 480+) takes ~1.5s to fully settle from a 2x/3x zoomed state; at 900ms the values are still decaying (scale 1.09, tx/ty ~6). Not a bug — spring behaviour is intentional and reaches identity if given enough time. Only relevant if a future automated test asserts identity within a shorter window.
